title: 2v2+1+1... Game 2 Large Goals
setup: 30X30 yard area with two large goals. The coach has a supply of balls.
instructions: The coach passes the ball to the center, toward one team.
The attacking team overlaps: the far player takes the ball and dribbles diagonally toward the coach.
The player near the coach overlaps to the far side.
THE TEAM IN POSSESSION CAN HAVE ONE EXTRA PLAYER, so they can turn and pass a teammate in.
If the defenders win the ball they can pass two players in, making it 4v3. Etc.
coachingPoints: Dribble and pass with the correct technique.
Don't wait for the defender to close you down - pass early.
Get a numbers advantage by passing someone in early.
Create width and depth when attacking.
